title: FloatButton
description: A button that floats at the top of the page.
whenToUse:
- For global functionality on the site.
- Buttons that can be seen wherever you browse.

examples.name: Basic
Type
examples.description: Change the type of the FloatButton with the `type` property.

examples.name: Shape
examples.description: Change the shape of the FloatButton with the `shape` property.

examples.name: Content
examples.description: Setting the `content` property allows you to show a FloatButton with a description.

examples.name: FloatButton with tooltip
examples.description: Setting the `tooltip` property shows the FloatButton with a tooltip.

examples.name: FloatButton Group
examples.description: When multiple buttons are used together, `<FloatButton.Group />` is recommended. By setting the `shape` property of FloatButton.Group, you can change the shape of group. The `shape` of the FloatButton.Group will override the `shape` of FloatButtons inside.

examples.name: Menu mode
examples.description: Open menu mode with `trigger`, which could be `hover` or `click`.

examples.name: Controlled mode
examples.description: Set the component to controlled mode through `open`, which need to be used together with `trigger`.

examples.name: placement
examples.description: Customize animation placement, providing four preset placement: `top`, `right`, `bottom`, `left`, the `top` position by default.

examples.name: draggable
examples.description: Implement drag-and-drop functionality with third-party libraries.

examples.name: BackTop
examples.description: `BackTop` makes it easy to go back to the top of the page.

examples.name: Progress ring
examples.description: Use `showProgress` to display the current scroll progress around the BackTop button edge.

examples.name: badge
Custom semantic dom styling
examples.description: You can customize the semantic dom style of FloatButton by passing objects/functions through `classNames` and `styles`.
